royalty_book_rerated_value.note: METAL RE-RATE of the cost-carried royalty book (value-analyst + balance-sheet pass, 2026-06-30). Cost book US$785.3M struck at ~$1,800 gold; spot ~$4,000 and realized $4,875/oz. Conservative re-rated total equity ~US$1.0B (range 0.95-1.15B = ~$4.1-5.0/sh on 230.8M sh); below the ~2x-book sell-side NAV (7 analysts, PT $6.00). verified.reason: REJECTED as a carried-book re-rate. US$1.0B is a forward NAV (~consensus PT $4.83 -> ~$1.11B equity) minus a haircut, NOT the audited royalty book. Tangible book (US$722M / $3.13/sh, 6-K Q1-2026) IS already the metal-complete royalty mark under mode=royalty. Refutations: (1) market prices GROY at ~0.995x book ($2.80, gold $4,029) so $1.0B asserts a ~39% mispricing; (2) only the PRODUCING slice re-rates and it is ALREADY inside the $785.3M cost book (double-count); dev/exploration/copper (Vares Cu, Cozamin) interests do not scale 1:1 with gold; (3) the US$119.8M deferred-tax liability stays and is not netted; (4) corroboration overstated - consensus is $4.83/8 analysts (cutting on valuation/dilution), not $6.00/2x book. A defensible PARTIAL re-rate needs the producing-slice carrying value + per-interest realized basis (UNSOURCED) and lands ~$800-850M at most. Anchor stays $3.13 audited book; keep royalty_rerate OFF.
